description: iOS (WP5): the bundled app in the main window may call the shell's sign-in/token/server/link commands plus the six iOS commands (server reset, app lock, APNs) and nothing else: no core:* plugin APIs, no opener, no fs, no shell, no prism-ios plugin commands (the Swift plugin is reached only from Rust), and none of the desktop extras (quick capture, notify, export). Remote origins get no IPC at all (no `remote` block).
